description: This file provides utility functions, hooks, and API interaction logic for frontend components interacting with a FastAPI backend in a React project. It includes functions for API requests, authentication, appointment management, doctor and slot management, profile handling, and notifications.

methods.name: apiRequest(endpoint, { method = "GET", token = null, headers = {}, body = null, params = null, ...rest } = {})
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with fetch, handles JSON parsing, error detection, and supports different HTTP methods with optional headers, body, and query params.

methods.name: useApiAuth()
methods.description: Hook managing user authentication, providing login and registration functions, along with loading and error state management.

methods.name: useAppointments(token, role)
methods.description: Hook for interacting with appointment data, including fetching, confirming, and rejecting appointments depending on user role.

methods.name: useDoctors(token)
methods.description: Hook for retrieving doctors with available slots and booking an appointment.

methods.name: useDoctorSlots(token)
methods.description: Hook for managing doctor time slots, including CRUD operations.

methods.name: useProfile(token, role)
methods.description: Hook for fetching and updating user profile data.

methods.name: useNotifications(token, role)
methods.description: Hook for fetching notifications and marking all as read.
